category: internal disciplinary finding against a senior official
people: Musa (MV) Mbhele (Managing Director of the South African Bank Note Company and employee of the South African Reserve Bank)
summary: The South African Reserve Bank dismissed Musa Mbhele on 21 January 2011 as Managing Director of the South African Bank Note Company and as an employee of the bank, following a formal disciplinary process; he had been suspended the previous year after weaknesses were uncovered at the South African Bank Note Company, the note-printing operation whose managing director he was.
source_title: Dismissal of MV (Musa) Mbhele, Managing Director of the South African Bank Note Company (South African Reserve Bank media statement, 21 January 2011, published on gov.za)
detail: A second South African episode distinct from the Bankorp/Absa and CIEX matter of 1985-2018 already on the map. The statement records that the Reserve Bank ran the disciplinary process and employed him; it does not state the South African Bank Note Company's ownership, so no subsidiary relationship is asserted here beyond what the statement says. The statement names a formal disciplinary process and not a specific offence.
refused_reason: The media statement records a dismissal after a formal disciplinary process and says weaknesses were uncovered at the South African Bank Note Company. It names no offence and makes no allegation against Mbhele. Filing it would assert misconduct the source does not state.
